value.rationale: The identifying-code optimum describes minimum sensor placements but not their repairability. Two adjacent Kneser graphs with equal optimal sensor count have strikingly different complete exchange connectivity: connected in one case, 280 Hamming components in the other. Exact finite structural classifications and degree spectra are natural meaningful configuration invariants, beyond a routine recapitulation of numerical minimum.
